decision: Statistical models forecast the 24 hours of day D in one call from their state at 00:00, using observed demand up to the hour starting at D-1 23:00; the direct strategy with one shared model (D10) stays for the feature-based models of later tasks.
evidence: ETS and ARIMA models produce multi-step forecasts from their own equations; the information set is the one D09 fixed, and lags of 1 to 23 hours were left out of the catalogue (D11) only because one direct model serves every horizon.

decision: Every model is fitted to log(1 + count); forecasts come back as max(exp(x) - 1, 0) and the cases set to zero are counted.
evidence: On fold 1 training hours the largest hourly standard deviation is network 5.2, Tongxiang 5.1, Xiuzhou 4.5, Nanhu 5.4 times the smallest on the count scale, against 2.0, 1.5, 1.7, 1.6 on the log scale; exp(x) - 1 lies between -1 and 0 when x < 0, hence the clip.

decision: Coefficients are estimated once per fold and level on the training hours; within the validation quarter the model is filtered with those fixed coefficients and each 00:00 issuance takes a dynamic 24-hour prediction.
evidence: A dynamic prediction from hour e uses observations before e only, so each forecast sees the data known at issuance; re-estimating every day would mean about 90 fits per fold and level. The perturbation check of Section 6 confirms that no later observation changes a forecast.

decision: The ETS structure per level, fixed for the four folds: network trend=none; Tongxiang trend=none; Xiuzhou trend=none; Nanhu trend=none.
evidence: Lowest AIC on fold 1 training hours (2020-04-01 to 2020-09-30); gap to the next candidate network 3.2, Tongxiang 6.0, Xiuzhou 5.7, Nanhu 5.8.

decision: The SARIMA structure per level, fixed for the four folds: network (2,0,1)(0,1,1)24; Tongxiang (2,0,1)(0,1,1)24; Xiuzhou (2,0,1)(0,1,1)24; Nanhu (2,0,1)(0,1,1)24.
evidence: Lowest AIC on fold 1 training hours (2020-04-01 to 2020-09-30); gap to the next candidate network 1.9, Tongxiang 1.4, Xiuzhou 0.2, Nanhu 1.6; d from the ADF and KPSS tests on the lag-24 difference: {'network': 0, 'Tongxiang': 0, 'Xiuzhou': 0, 'Nanhu': 0}.

decision: The MSTL + ARIMA structure per level, fixed for the four folds: network ARIMA(2,0,1)+const; Tongxiang ARIMA(2,0,1)+const; Xiuzhou ARIMA(2,0,1)+const; Nanhu ARIMA(2,0,1)+const.
evidence: Lowest AIC on fold 1 training hours (2020-04-01 to 2020-09-30); gap to the next candidate network 17.3, Tongxiang 13.2, Xiuzhou 35.8, Nanhu 9.8.

decision: sarimax_cal adds 6 day-of-week dummies (Monday is the reference), the holiday flag and the adjusted-working-day flag to the SARIMA structure of the level, without a search of its own; sarimax_weather adds the day-D temperature to these inputs.
evidence: The calendar is published in advance (D02); Task 1 found a weekly cycle the daily season does not carry (D05: snaive_week 1.047) and holiday effects (D06); keeping the SARIMA structure isolates the effect of the inputs.

decision: Weather enters only through sarimax_weather, as the temperature of day D, read as the forecast available at 00:00 and repeated over the 24 hours; the network value is the mean of the three districts.
evidence: Task 1 Spearman correlations with daily network demand: temperature +0.625, humidity +0.045, precipitation +0.012; one temperature per district-day, 548 days with none missing; the districts correlate at 0.999 or more.

decision: Weather is dropped for later tasks: the day-D temperature does not lower the primary MASE of the SARIMAX model.
evidence: Primary MASE sarimax_weather 0.7616 against sarimax_cal 0.7536 (difference +0.0080); lower in 4 of the 16 (level, fold) cells; the gain is an upper bound because the recorded temperature stands in for a forecast.

decision: statsmodels 0.15.0 is added to requirements.txt and is the only new package of Task 2.
evidence: ETS, SARIMA, SARIMAX, MSTL, the ADF and KPSS tests and the Ljung-Box test are not in the Task 1 pins; statsmodels 0.15.0 runs with pandas 3.0.6 and NumPy 2.5.3.

decision: sarimax_cal is carried forward as the statistical reference for Task 3.
evidence: Lowest primary MASE among the statistical models: sarimax_cal 0.7536 against mean_4w 0.8691; below mean_4w in 16 of the 16 (level, fold) cells; per fold 0.768, 0.619, 0.743, 0.884.
